name: SecretValue
description: SecretValue schema from Amazon Secrets Manager API

Name.description: The friendly name of the secret.

VersionId.description: The unique identifier of this version of the secret.

SecretBinary.description: The decrypted secret value in binary format.

SecretString.description: The decrypted secret value in string format.

VersionStages.description: A list of the staging labels that are attached to this version.

CreatedDate.description: The date and time that this version of the secret was created.
